executiveSummary: Adversaries are actively targeting Siemens S7-200/300/400/1200/1500 PLCs using AI-assisted tooling and Internet scanning, creating immediate risk to multiple U.S. critical infrastructure sectors. Security Advisory Multiple Internet-facing access gateways are under active exploitation: NetScaler ADC/Gateway critical RCEs and a reported zero-day; F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth RCE; and Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (KEV). JPCERT NetScaler Heise Zero-Day JPCERT F5 CISA SD-WAN KEV CISA bulletins highlight multiple OT/ICS gateway flaws (Advantech WISE-6610 and EKI-1242EIMS) with unauthenticated command execution and public exploits-high-likelihood ingress paths into IIoT/SCADA. CISA SB26-257 CISA SB26-264 Ransomware operators are abusing enterprise platforms already in CI environments: Warlock exploits on-prem SharePoint (victims include a water utility), and PAYLOAD ransomware hijacks Active Directory via domain-root GPOs. View Article IR Report Email/security edge devices remain high-risk: CISA added FortiMail to KEV; JPCERT reports Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQLi with observed exploitation; Zammad helpdesk CVEs now in KEV and exploited in the wild. CISA KEV FortiMail JPCERT Cisco SEG CISA KEV Zammad Additional OT-adjacent risks include Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo controllers leaking credentials over HTTP (patches available) and Meari IoT cloud API authorization flaws without vendor fixes-mandating isolation and strict access controls. CISA ICS Advisory CISA ICS Advisory

items: Warlock (aka Longlegs/Storm-2603) exploits SharePoint to disable security controls and stage ransomware, with victims including a water utility. Defenders should hunt web shells, VS Code Tunnels, and SYSVOL staging. View Article

Ransomware operators hijack AD Group Policy for encryptionless extortion, pushing policy-based disruption and ransom notes enterprise-wide-techniques likely to impact domain-joined HMIs/EWSs if present. IR Report
Crimeware campaigns (e.g., MovieReaper torrent malware) present IT-to-OT pivot risk via persistent backdoors and modular data theft. Technical Report

relevance: Current activity clusters around edge-access devices and industrial gateways that frequently bridge enterprise and operational environments. Actively exploited NetScaler/F5/Cisco SD-WAN issues provide turnkey ingress to identity and management planes. Concurrently, CISA's Siemens S7 advisory flags direct PLC targeting with AI-enabled tooling, raising the likelihood of operational impact if network segmentation and controller protections are weak. Advantech gateway vulnerabilities heighten risk at the field edge where IIoT connectivity meets SCADA.

items: F5 BIG-IP APM (CVE-2026-94127) - Unauthenticated RCE on OAuth endpoint; hotfix/iRule mitigations available. Advisory
NetScaler ADC/Gateway (CVE-2026-88771/88772) - RCEs; active scans/exploitation; new zero-day reported. Advisory Zero-Day Report
Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager (CVE-2026-76504) - Added to KEV for active exploitation; immediate remediation required. KEV
Advantech WISE-6610 - Remote command injection (public exploits); ICS field gateway risk. CISA Bulletin
Advantech EKI-1242EIMS - Multiple unauth flaws in edgserver mgmt (TCP/5058), OPC UA DoS, code/command injection. CISA Bulletin
Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal - Added to KEV; observed exploitation against email security appliances. KEV
Zammad Helpdesk (CVE-2026-102489/102490) - Actively exploited; session fixation and privilege issues. KEV
Johnson Controls EasyIO Neo EC/CW - Cleartext credential/session exposure over HTTP; fixed firmware available. CISA ICS
Meari IoT Cloud OpenAPI - Missing authorization enables cross-tenant device control and data access; no fix planned. CISA ICS
Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) - Mass exploitation reported; enterprise HR portals often adjacent to CI operations. Investigation

descriptions: Edge device exploitation and web exploitation: unauth RCE on ADC/VPN/SD-WAN/Email gateways; zero-day targeting of SAML flows.
Credential access and domain dominance: DCSync, ADCS ESC1 abuse, Machine Account Quota abuse, excessive cloud app permissions; domain-root GPO hijack for disruption.
Initial access via web shells on SharePoint; DLL sideloading; VS Code Tunnels for covert remote access; BYOVD to kill security tools.
AI-assisted discovery/exploitation: automated scanning (Censys/ZoomEye), script generation for S7comm/snap7 interactions with PLCs.
Persistence and defense evasion: token abuse, ad-hoc signing (macOS), LaunchAgents/.zshrc persistence, msedge.exe masquerade in Telemetry path, SYSVOL staging.
Command and control: OAuth endpoint abuse, Solana blockchain-assisted C2 discovery (MovieReaper), ScreenConnect misuse.

outlook72h: Expect continued exploitation of NetScaler and F5 APM surfaces; prioritize patch windows and deploy temporary mitigations (disable DTLS/SAML where feasible; apply APM iRule). Increase monitoring for abnormal authentication flows, token issuance, and webshell indicators on remote access and SharePoint servers. Harden/patch Advantech gateways and strictly ACL management interfaces; raise alerting thresholds for unauthorized commands and new processes on field devices. Sweep for PLC exposure (TCP/102) beyond intended conduits; baseline S7 traffic and alert on write/PUT/GET operations. Review KEV coverage (FortiMail, Zammad, SD-WAN) on externally exposed assets; complete compromise assessments before/after patch.
